Corridor #4 - connects to existing I-94 (North-South Freeway) with an interchange connection at South 6th Street located approximately 3,000 feet north of Layton Avenue.

The corridor then extends southward from I-94 along the atandoned right of way of the North Shore Pailroad (South 6th Street) to a point south of Edgerton Avenue and east of Moller Park.

At this point the corridor continues southeasterly to the airport entrance road. The approximate length of this route is 1.65 miles.
Corridor #5 - (Recommended corridor for project construction) This connects to existing I-94 (North-South Freeway) with an interchange connection approximately 1,500 feet south of Grange Avenue and proceeds easterly and parallel to Grange Avenue. Before it crosses the C.M. St. P. A.P. Bailroad it curves to the northeast crossing Grange Avenue just east of Cth Street and proceeds east of Nowell Avenue where it surves northward for approximately 400 feet to the airport entrance road. The approximate length of this route is 1.52 miles
